typecheck.description: tsc 7.1 over the Worker (the Workers runtime's types), and over the build, the browser script and the tests (Node and the DOM).

test.description: The site's Vitest suite, under Node. It builds the site itself (into a temporary directory), so it doesn't wait on build. It reads what the site copies or states from elsewhere: the client's tokens (globals.css), tones (shell/tones.ts) and character art (locals/art), and the facts the legal pages state (the session cookie in better-auth.ts and host-cookies.ts, the relay's registration expiry, the phone's lease), the outside model endpoint (inference/openai-compatible.ts) the self-host copy accounts for, removal's refusal and transfer (purge/person.ts, auth/accounts.ts), and the menu labels the pages name (the app's More, Account, Settings and Sign out; the web's user menu, Settings, People and Deactivate).

build.description: vite build: the pages (rendered from src/build), the stylesheet (Tailwind 4), the browser script, the character art (from the client's, cream tiles stripped) and the site's files, into dist/ for wrangler's assets.
